note: Six canonical personas for the persona landing pages. Industry files in data/persona-pages/ carry the message-matched copy for each industry x persona pair; industry personaTitles in data/professional-services.json carry the industry-specific role titles.

personas.concern: Growing the firm without the growth being hostage to hiring, and without the next stage of growth diluting what made the firm good.
personas.readsFor: Revenue per professional, the growth plan, succession of expertise, and whether the firm's name is protected.
personas.ctaFrame: A working session on where your firm's growth is constrained, and which workflows would move it.

personas.concern: Delivery capacity, utilization, and process reliability. Getting more through the same organization without the wheels coming off.
personas.readsFor: Cycle times, utilization, handoff friction, and whether an improvement survives contact with a busy quarter.
personas.ctaFrame: A working session on your delivery bottlenecks, and which two workflows to instrument first.

personas.concern: Client outcomes and the quality of the work that carries the practice's name. Growth is welcome; dilution is not.
personas.readsFor: Work quality, team development, client relationships, and whether AI raises the floor without lowering the ceiling.
personas.ctaFrame: A working session on where your practice loses senior time to work that is beneath it.

personas.concern: One governed platform instead of tool sprawl. Access control, data boundaries, and something IT can actually operate and defend.
personas.readsFor: Architecture, access model, vendor posture, auditability, and whether governance is designed in or bolted on.
personas.ctaFrame: A working session on the platform and control architecture, before the business picks its own tools.

personas.concern: Client confidentiality, professional accountability, and the firm's obligations. AI use the firm could explain to its most demanding client.
personas.readsFor: Confidentiality boundaries, accountability for outputs, evidence and traceability, and what happens when something goes wrong.
personas.ctaFrame: A working session on the control set: boundaries, review points, and the evidence trail behind them.

personas.concern: Whether the spend returns, measured honestly. Margin visibility, not a vendor's hockey stick.
personas.readsFor: Cost of the program, where the hours actually go, payback discipline, and metrics that would survive a board question.
personas.ctaFrame: A working session on the honest business case: what to measure, and what the numbers would need to show.
